change: chore/enterprise-ci-gates: adopt enterprise skills as enforced per-skill CI gates

architectural-decision-records.why: This change ships architecturally significant decisions (ADR-0002, ADR-0003) and wires an ADR gate.
architectural-decision-records.what: Wrote ADR-0002 and ADR-0003; wired check:adr as the architectural-decision-records CI check.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: Configured the mechanical architecture gate and wired it as judge-arch's own CI check.
judge-arch.what: Authored arch-gate.config.json and decisions.md; wired check:architecture + check:links as the judge-arch check.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

arch-encode.why: Encoded the Supabase/Sanity data-ownership rule as a mechanical arch-gate rule and wired its discrimination gate.
arch-encode.what: Added the 'Sanity owns prose, not facts' forbid rule; wired check:discriminate as the arch-encode check.
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: The standing system shape (layers, ownership) is recorded and enforced by the architecture gate.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: Recorded the intended shape in decisions.md and AGENTS.md; wired check:architecture as this skill's check.
quotes: Most systems do not fail because nobody knew the right pattern

verifiable-quality-gates.why: Mirrored the component discrimination suite so every vendored gate script is proven to detect.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: Added the 29-file test suite and npm test; wired it as the verifiable-quality-gates CI check; proved it green (434 pass).
quotes: A quality gate is only worth the failures it catches

skeptical-audit.why: Every factual claim in the ADRs and this receipt carries an evidence state and a named limitation.
skeptical-audit.what: Recorded honest limits in ADR-0002/0003; wired check:evidence (skill-evidence-contract) as this skill's check.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

pattern-selector.why: Wired the pattern-catalog completeness gate as pattern-selector's own CI check.
pattern-selector.what: Wired check:patterns over the design and enterprise pattern catalogs (61 entries validated).
quotes: Two mistakes cost you, and they pull in opposite directions

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: Seeded and validated the data map that the pii and retention gates enforce.
compliance-data-lifecycle.what: Authored data-map.json with lawful basis and retention; wired check:retention + check:pii as this skill's check.
quotes: Two things quietly block software from being enterprise-ready. It cannot prove it handles data lawfully

release-deployment-safety.why: Wired the expand/contract migration-safety gate and proved it bites on a destructive migration.
release-deployment-safety.what: Wired check:migrations (guarded) as this skill's check; verified it fails on DROP TABLE and passes a safe ADD COLUMN.
quotes: Most production outages are not caused by bad code. They are caused by how good code was shipped

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: Declared the product audiences and wired the BDD structural gate as this skill's check.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: Authored features/bdd-config.json (audiences) and wired check:gherkin + check:bdd-tags (guarded).
quotes: A feature isn't done when the happy path works for the person who built it

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: Wired the test-shape (pyramid) gate as this skill's check, activating when a JUnit report exists.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: Wired check:test-shape (guarded) as the comprehensive-test-strategy CI check.
quotes: BDD scenarios prove a feature behaves correctly, but that is only part of what strong teams test

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: Wired the OWASP mechanical lints as this skill's check, activating when application source lands.
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: Wired check:owasp:lints (guarded) as the owasp-secure-coding-bdd CI check.
quotes: Most breaches come from a short list of mistakes that are well understood and well documented

universal-browser-device-support.why: Wired the no-user-agent-sniffing gate as this skill's check, activating when source lands.
universal-browser-device-support.what: Wired check:no-ua (guarded) as the universal-browser-device-support CI check.
quotes: on a fast laptop can be broken in Safari, unusable on a 360px phone

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: Wired the a11y checklist/axe gate as this skill's check, activating when a UI surface lands.
universal-accessibility-wcag.what: Wired check:a11y:checklist (guarded) as the universal-accessibility-wcag CI check.
quotes: Roughly one in six people lives with a disability

sre-operational-readiness.why: Wired the alert-hygiene gate as this skill's check, activating when alert rules land.
sre-operational-readiness.what: Wired check:alerts (guarded) as the sre-operational-readiness CI check.
quotes: systems treat reliability as a measured, budgeted engineering property, not a hope

usability-ux-universal-design.why: The library ships no standalone lint, so this skill is enforced by receipt coupling to every UI change; its CI check asserts that coupling is wired.
usability-ux-universal-design.what: Coupled usability-ux to UI changes in skill-receipt.config.json and wired the assertion as its CI check.
quotes: makes a product possible to use for people with

architectural-decision-records.why: Scaffolding the app on Next.js is an architecturally significant decision.
architectural-decision-records.what: Wrote ADR-0004 recording Next.js over CRA and the initial scaffold.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: Reviewed every new code file against the four questions and refined the gate config.
judge-arch.what: Added the arch-review matrix for 7 files; excluded the Sanity client from the one-Supabase-client rule.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

arch-encode.why: Refined a mechanical arch-gate rule so it stops a real false-positive without weakening intent.
arch-encode.what: Excluded src/lib/sanity from the one-Supabase-client rule (its createClient is a different client).
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: Applied the UI -> service -> lib layering; business data lives in a service, not the component.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: Put site identity in a pure service and the clients in a single integration layer.
quotes: Most systems do not fail because nobody knew the right pattern

verifiable-quality-gates.why: Shipped a test with the new behaviour so a regression would fail.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: Added a unit test for the site-info service; it passes under node --test.
quotes: A quality gate is only worth the failures it catches

skeptical-audit.why: Stated honest limits rather than overclaiming the scaffold.
skeptical-audit.what: Recorded in ADR-0004 and the a11y record that the accessibility verdict needs human sign-off and backend paths are unexercised.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: Wrote the home-page behaviour as a fully-tagged Gherkin scenario set.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: Added features/home.feature with happy-path and accessibility scenarios, @audience:newbie.
quotes: A feature isn't done when the happy path works for the person who built it

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: Added a unit test at the service layer alongside the behavioural feature.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: site-info.test.ts covers the pure service; the feature covers the page behaviour.
quotes: BDD scenarios prove a feature behaves correctly, but that is only part of what strong teams test

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: Handled the Supabase keys with the service-role key kept strictly server-side.
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: admin.ts is server-only and documented as bypassing RLS; the anon client notes RLS is required.
quotes: Most breaches come from a short list of mistakes that are well understood and well documented

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: Built the page to WCAG and produced a conformance record for all 55 criteria.
universal-accessibility-wcag.what: Semantic HTML, lang, skip link, focus-visible, contrast; a11y-conformance.json passes the checklist gate.
quotes: Roughly one in six people lives with a disability

universal-browser-device-support.why: Used responsive, feature-detection-friendly CSS with no user-agent sniffing.
universal-browser-device-support.what: Fluid type, rem units, max-width, prefers-color-scheme; no-ua gate passes.
quotes: on a fast laptop can be broken in Safari, unusable on a 360px phone

usability-ux-universal-design.why: Kept the page simple, readable, and predictable for low-literacy users.
usability-ux-universal-design.what: Plain language, large base font, clear hierarchy, single obvious column.
quotes: makes a product possible to use for people with

pattern-selector.why: A simple layered scaffold (UI -> service -> lib); no non-trivial design pattern selection was needed.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: No personal data or schema change in this scaffold; the committed data map is unchanged.

release-deployment-safety.why: No database migration or deployment-config change; the build is a static scaffold.

sre-operational-readiness.why: No service endpoints, alert rules, or SLOs are introduced in this scaffold.

change: feat/core-schema: core data model, Source entity, verification state

architectural-decision-records.why: Two foundational, expensive-to-retrofit decisions ship as ADRs in this change.
architectural-decision-records.what: Wrote ADR-0005 (data ownership) and ADR-0006 (verification/publication state model).
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: Reviewed the schema against the four questions: one owner per fact, public reads only published, no web concerns.
judge-arch.what: Designed the tables, the record_status state model, and RLS so data ownership and boundaries hold at the database.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: Applied relational data-architecture: normalized entities, one Source entity, a shared state enum, indexed foreign keys.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: Modeled politicians/parties/bills/policies/votes with a single provenance and verification model.
quotes: Most systems do not fail because nobody knew the right pattern

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: Classified every PII-looking column, gave each a lawful basis and retention, and added a tamper-evident append-only audit log.
compliance-data-lifecycle.what: Updated data-map.json for the schema columns; added audit_log (admin-read, SECURITY DEFINER insert, no update/delete).
quotes: Two things quietly block software from being enterprise-ready. It cannot prove it handles data lawfully

release-deployment-safety.why: Wrote the initial schema expand/contract-safe so it is a clean, additive, lock-free migration.
release-deployment-safety.what: All additive CREATE statements; CREATE INDEX suppressed with a reason for the brand-new tables; the migration-safety gate passes.
quotes: Most production outages are not caused by bad code. They are caused by how good code was shipped

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: Enforced access control at the database: RLS so the public reads only published rows and all writes require an admin.
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: Enabled RLS on every table, added published-read and admin-manage policies, kept the audit insert in a SECURITY DEFINER function.
quotes: Most breaches come from a short list of mistakes that are well understood and well documented

skeptical-audit.why: Stated the honest limits: RLS cannot prove a verification was done correctly, and the service-role key must stay server-only.
skeptical-audit.what: Recorded those limits in ADR-0005 and ADR-0006 rather than claiming the model guarantees correctness.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

arch-encode.why: No new mechanical arch-gate rule was added in this schema change; the existing ownership rule already covers it.

verifiable-quality-gates.why: No new gate or check script in this change; the migration-safety and pii gates already prove the schema is safe and classified.

pattern-selector.why: The record_status lifecycle is a state model, but no code-level design-pattern selection was required in this schema-only change.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: A database schema change has no user-facing behaviour to script yet; scenarios come with the admin and read features.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: No application code in this change; the schema is validated by the migration-safety and pii gates.

sre-operational-readiness.why: No service endpoints, alert rules, or SLOs are introduced in this change.

universal-browser-device-support.why: No frontend code in this change.

usability-ux-universal-design.why: No user-facing flow or copy in this change.
